# testdata/test_element_ref_qualified.sngl, executed: that fixture is only
# type-checked, and a ref the checker resolves must also be one the
# interpreter's test runner finds and clicks.

sngl test --platform none refs.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'
stdout 'counter/testQualifiedRefIsAddressable'
stdout 'pair/testQualifiedRefInAChildIsAddressable'

# The child written as a qualified call statement into another package: the
# descendant search followed only a bare call, so `c.lbl` was no member of pair.
sngl test --platform none child
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'
stdout 'pair/testQualifiedChildCall'

-- refs.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    none { html }
}

// A node written through an import alias is the same node written bare, so a
// test reaches its #id the same way: resolving the host by the written name
// looked up "ui.button" in scope, found nothing, and reported no member.
func testQualifiedRefIsAddressable(t test.Test, c counter) {
    c.inc.click()
    t.assert(c.count == 1)
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.box != null)
}

func testQualifiedRefInAChildIsAddressable(t test.Test, c pair) {
    t.assert(c.lbl[1].value == "b")
}

component counter ui.node {
    var count = 0

    ui.vbox #box {
        ui.button #inc(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
        ui.text #shown(value="{count}")
    }
}

component labelled(label string) ui.node {
    ui.text #lbl(value=label)
}

component pair ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        labelled(label="a")
        labelled(label="b")
    }
}

ui.window {
    counter()
}
-- child/main.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import w "./widgets"

output {
    none { html }
}

func testQualifiedChildCall(t test.Test, c pair) {
    t.assert(c.lbl[1].value == "b")
}

component pair ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        w.labelled(label="a")
        w.labelled(label="b")
    }
}

ui.window {
    pair()
}
-- child/widgets/w.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component labelled(label string) ui.node {
    ui.text #lbl(value=label)
}
